lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Nani, stop the bike right now before we both end up flying [beat] off the edge of this bridge!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Pipe down Nix, I haven't missed a jump [beat] since the great underground street race of nineteen-eighty-four!

lines.speaker: tuli
lines.text: You actually expect us to believe this? Grandma is a retired librarian [beat] who only knits sweaters and drinks tea!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: That tea was just a cover, and these itchy sweaters [beat] are actually flame-retardant racing gear for the whole family!

lines.speaker: rafiq
lines.text: Look at the trophy cabinet hidden behind the false wall in the basement [beat] if you think she is joking, kids.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Wait, so Dad knew all along that we were the direct descendants [beat] of the most legendary street racing crew in history?

lines.speaker: milli
lines.text: Every time she said she went to the grocery store [beat] she was actually setting speed records on the main highway!

lines.speaker: phupu
lines.text: I didn't want you to know because you can't even ride a skateboard [beat] without crying for a bandage and a hug!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: That is a total lie Auntie, I just have very sensitive knees [beat] and a very healthy respect for the laws of gravity!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Enough talking, the final race against the neighbor's secret gang [beat] starts in exactly five minutes at the warehouse!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: If you actually win this Nani, I promise to never complain [beat] about your weird spicy lentil soup ever again!

lines.speaker: nani
lines.text: Deal, now hold on tight Nix because I am about to show you [beat] why the city used to call me the Asphalt Queen!

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: And that is how Nix discovered that his family tree [beat] was actually just one long line of adrenaline-fueled street racing legends.
